name: World Land Trust partner project funding
summary: Funding for partner NGOs and indigenous organisations, mostly in the Global South, to create and protect reserves, with habitat restoration and protection alongside. Concept notes go through the Grants Connect portal.

eligibility.rule: The project benefits biodiversity, communities and climate without net negative impacts
Main objective is creating or expanding reserves; supporting activities are not funded on their own
The project is not an expedition

applicant_types.quote: However, we may also support other organisations, including those with a focus in other areas (for example, development NGOs and indigenous organisations)

access.quote: Once your account is set up you will be able to select the 'Start new application' button.

effort.quote: Setting up your account and then subsequent submission of a concept is self-explanatory.

eligibility.quote: All WLT funded projects need to have clear benefits, and no net negative impact to biodiversity, communities and the climate.
These latter activities are not funded on their own and would only be considered if they are part of a wider conservation project with the creation or expansion of reserves as the main objective.
